    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AlertController
    Controller responsible for managing alerts generated by sensors.
    AlertLevel
    Represents the severity level of a mold or sensor alert.
    AlertLogger
    Interface responsible for logging alert-related messages.
    ArchiveRoom
    Represents an archive room composed of four walls and an environmental context.
    BinaryExporter
    Utility class responsible for serializing and deserializing simulation state using binary (Java object) format.
    Cell
    Represents a single cell in the wall grid.
    CellState
    Represents all possible states of a cell in the simulation.
    DrawMode
    Defines the drawing modes available in the UI for modifying the simulation grid.
    Environment
    Global environmental conditions of the archive room.
    EventManager
    Handles external events that modify the simulation environment and walls.
    EventType
    Represents the type of sensor or system event occurring in the simulation.
    ExternalEvent
    Represents external events that can affect the simulation environment or walls.
    GridController
    Controller for the grid interface.
    GridScale
    Utility class providing conversions between real-world measurements and simulation grid units.
    GridView
    JavaFX Canvas-based grid renderer for the mold simulation.
    GridView.CellClickListener
     
    GridView.InteractionCompleteListener
     
    GridView.ShelfPlacementListener
     
    InteractionMode
    Defines interaction modes available in the simulation UI.
    LocationContext
    Represents the currently selected room and wall in the simulation UI.
    Main
    Entry point of the ArchiveShield Mold Risk Simulator application.
    MainView
    Main JavaFX view of the Mold Simulation application.
    MoldSensor
    Sensor responsible for detecting mold levels and generating alert events for walls and shelves in the simulation.
    MoldSpecies
    Represents mold species used in the simulation.
    PdfExporter
    Utility class responsible for generating a PDF report from simulation statistics, environment data, and alert logs.
    PdfExportService
    Service responsible for generating and opening PDF simulation reports.
    RecommendationEngine
    Engine responsible for generating textual recommendations based on sensor events.
    SensorEvent
    Represents an event generated by a mold sensor during the simulation.
    Shelf
    Represents a shelf unit in the archive room.
    ShelfValue
    Represents the importance level of a shelf in the simulation.
    SimulationController
    Controller responsible for executing the mold simulation.
    SimulationSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of the entire simulation state at a given simulation week.
    SimulationState
    Complete serialized state of the simulation used for save and load operations.
    Statistics
    Computes and stores statistical indicators for a simulation step.
    Wall
    Represents a 2D grid wall used in the simulation.
    WallConfigDialog
    Startup dialog used to configure the simulation walls.
    WallConfigDialog.WallConfig
    Data holder representing configuration of a single wall.
    WallContext
    Stores all data associated with a wall in the simulation.
    WallManager
    Manages a collection of wall contexts and provides navigation between them.
    WallMaterial
    Represents the material composition of a wall in the simulation.
    WallPreviewView
    JavaFX canvas component used to render a preview of a wall segment.
